title: 勒奇山基線隧道
summary: 勒奇山案例的核心不是單純延長隧道，而是已營運路線如何面對分期建造留下的容量與介面限制。BLS公開資料將其描述為約35公里的基線隧道；本課把未裝設段、單線衝突、維修窗口、出水與施工隔離分開，逐步建立可供營運和擴建共同審查的證據鏈。
summaryEn: The Lotschberg case concerns the capacity and interfaces left by staged construction rather than length alone. BLS describes an approximately 35 km base tunnel. This course separates unfinished bore sections, single-track conflicts, maintenance windows, water conditions and construction isolation, building an evidence chain that operations and expansion teams can review together.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「服務邊界與路線代價」與「單線瓶頸與時距容量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Service boundaries and alignment cost" and "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「路線里程與端點」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alignment chainage and endpoints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「路線里程與端點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alignment chainage and endpoints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「路線里程與端點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alignment chainage and endpoints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 服務邊界與路線代價
knowledge.text: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「勒奇山基線隧道」的「服務邊界與路線代價：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「隧道模型掘進交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Service boundaries and alignment cost: mechanism and system paths” in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tunnel model drive handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Service boundaries and alignment cost" is correct?
options: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。
比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。
單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。
optionsEn: The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity.
One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.
quiz.explanation: 比較勒奇山已營運段與擴建段的共同端點，將未裝軌洞體與不存在的洞段分開，避免把土建完成當交通容量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare common endpoints across operating and expansion sections, distinguishing an unfitted bore from an unexcavated section before assigning transport capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「路線里程與端點」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.52 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.52 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.2 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.52 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.52 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「服務邊界與路線代價」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Service boundaries and alignment cost", which statement holds?
options: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。
增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。
原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。
optionsEn: No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：長度=13.2 km；速度=60 km/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: length=13.2 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.2 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「路線里程與端點」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alignment chainage and endpoints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。
knowledge.textEn: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「服務邊界與路線代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Service boundaries and alignment cost"?
options: 用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。
optionsEn: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 用營運配置圖與工程分區核對每段可通行狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile operating diagrams and works sections to identify the usable status of each segment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 服務邊界與路線代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Service boundaries and alignment cost: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「路線里程與端點」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alignment chainage and endpoints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。
knowledge.textEn: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「服務邊界與路線代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Service boundaries and alignment cost" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。
單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities.
One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.
quiz.explanation: 只有洞體未裝軌的段落若算入容量，會虛構列車交會點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting an unfitted bore creates fictitious train-passing opportunities. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「區段占用時間」如何影響勒奇山基線隧道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section occupation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Lotschberg Base Tunnel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。一段單線或共用道岔會把連續鐵路變成受時間窗限制的系統，清空時間與衝突進路和列車行走時間同樣重要。單方向理論容量只提供上界比較；雙向交會、延誤傳播及維修封鎖會改變可實現班次，必須在共同時距圖中檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「區段占用時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic. A single-track section or shared turnout creates time-window constraints, making clearance and conflicting routes as important as travel time. One-direction theoretical capacity gives only a comparison bound. Opposing movements, propagated delays and maintenance closures alter achievable service and must be examined together on a common timetable diagram. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section occupation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「區段占用時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Section occupation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量
knowledge.text: 以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。一段單線或共用道岔會把連續鐵路變成受時間窗限制的系統，清空時間與衝突進路和列車行走時間同樣重要。
knowledge.textEn: At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic. A single-track section or shared turnout creates time-window constraints, making clearance and conflicting routes as important as travel time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單線瓶頸與時距容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity" is correct?
options: 單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。
optionsEn: One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic.
quiz.explanation: 以勒奇山單線與雙線相接為情境，將對向列車等待和清空時間分開，辨認貨客混行的容量限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At a single-to-double-track transition, separate opposing-train waiting from clearance time and identify the constraints imposed by mixed passenger and freight traffic. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「區段占用時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Section occupation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h。僅把區段占用增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.24324 trains/h。邊界：單方向理論容量，未含對向衝突、延誤或維修；不是本工程實測或允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min. C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h. Increasing only occupation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.24324 trains/h. Boundary: One-direction theoretical capacity without opposing conflicts, delay or maintenance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h。僅把區段占用增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為3.24324 trains/h。邊界：單方向理論容量，未含對向衝突、延誤或維修；不是本工程實測或允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min. C=60/(tocc+tclear)=3.52941 trains/h. Increasing only occupation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 3.24324 trains/h. Boundary: One-direction theoretical capacity without opposing conflicts, delay or maintenance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「單線瓶頸與時距容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。
支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。
兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min.
Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：區段占用=15 min；清空餘裕=2 min。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: occupation=15 min; clearance=2 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「區段占用時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section occupation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。從列車通過與路線釋放時間戳重建占用，對照進路衝突表，再測試一班延誤如何影響後續交會而非只看平均準點。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Reconstruct occupation from passage and release timestamps, compare the route-conflict table and test how one delay affects subsequent meets. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：本案「區段占用時間」的交付需回答：重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。容量報告附衝突進路、列車性能和維修窗，任何新增班次須由營運方用可重播的時距圖驗證，不只比較單一每小時數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the section occupation time handover must address the following evidence: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Capacity reports include conflicting routes, train performance and maintenance windows; operations validates additions with replayable timetables rather than one hourly figure.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。從列車通過與路線釋放時間戳重建占用，對照進路衝突表，再測試一班延誤如何影響後續交會而非只看平均準點。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。
knowledge.textEn: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Reconstruct occupation from passage and release timestamps, compare the route-conflict table and test how one delay affects subsequent meets. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 本案「區段占用時間」的交付需回答：重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。容量報告附衝突進路、列車性能和維修窗，任何新增班次須由營運方用可重播的時距圖驗證，不只比較單一每小時數字。
knowledge.textEn: For Lotschberg Base Tunnel, the section occupation time handover must address the following evidence: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Capacity reports include conflicting routes, train performance and maintenance windows; operations validates additions with replayable timetables rather than one hourly figure.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單線瓶頸與時距容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。
只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added.
Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
quiz.explanation: 重播一個尖峰時段的占用紀錄，加入一列晚到貨車。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Replay one peak-period occupancy record with a delayed freight train added. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單線瓶頸與時距容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「區段占用時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section occupation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。把清空時間省略或把雙向列車當同方向排列會高估容量，實際服務可能需要長時間等待才能保留安全間隔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. Omitting clearance or treating opposing trains as one-direction traffic overstates capacity and requires long real waits to preserve separation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單方向理論容量只提供上界比較；雙向交會、延誤傳播及維修封鎖會改變可實現班次，必須在共同時距圖中檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Opposing movements, propagated delays and maintenance closures alter achievable service and must be examined together on a common timetable diagram.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單向理論列車數可以直接當作雙向可承諾營運容量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One-direction theoretical train count can be promised as two-way operational capacity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。把清空時間省略或把雙向列車當同方向排列會高估容量，實際服務可能需要長時間等待才能保留安全間隔。
knowledge.textEn: One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. Omitting clearance or treating opposing trains as one-direction traffic overstates capacity and requires long real waits to preserve separation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單線瓶頸與時距容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Single-track bottlenecks and headway capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。
只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity.
quiz.explanation: 只算單向班距會漏掉對向衝突，使時刻表名目容量無法實現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One-direction headways omit opposing conflicts and overstate timetable capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
